item.title: How to use HUGO to make a blog website.
item.description:
Introduction

This post is about how I made this website to begin with. It’s very simple to set up.

If you haven’t caught it already, this website is made with HUGO, which is a static website generator that, in this case, converts markdown files I write in Obsidian to HTML files for use with the website.

So why did I decide on HUGO? Well, I had 3 goals in mind when I was making this website:
